policy.name: get_policy_section
policy.description:
Return every passage of one Policy Document section and its sub-sections, in order.

        Use when: a search hit points at a section and you need the rest of it, or you know exactly which
        section you need (e.g. RSE-APR-01 §2 for approvers).
        Don't use when: you don't know the section; search with search_policy first.

Passage.description: One retrieved Chunk with its citation metadata. `text` is the full Chunk.
Passage.title: Passage

policy.name: search_policy
policy.description:
Search Ridgeline's Policy Corpus and return the most relevant passages with citation fields.

        Use when: you need policy text to answer or cite anything about Ridgeline's rules; write your own
        query, and search again with different words (or narrower doc_ids) if the results are thin.
        Don't use when: you already have the passage this turn, or you need a whole section you can name
        (use get_policy_section). evidence "none" means nothing in the corpus matches: don't state policy.

query.description: Your own search query: short, keyword-style, about one topic.
query.title: Query

doc_ids.description: Optional: only search these Policy Documents, e.g. ['RSE-PTO-01'].

hr.name: check_policy_compliance
hr.description:
Run the deterministic Compliance Check on a concrete request and return the outcome, approver, each
        rule checked (with its citation) and computed values such as working days and reimbursable amounts.

        Use when: the Requester has a concrete PTO request (dates), temporary remote work (where and when) or
        expense item (category and amount) and wants to know if it's allowed and who approves.
        Don't use when: the question is general, or the dates/location are too vague to check (ask instead).

hr.name: create_mock_hr_ticket
hr.description:
Mock Action: open an HR ticket for the Requester (simulated; saved for this session). Runs only after
        the user confirms. conduct tickets go to HR Confidential with a minimal summary.

        Use when: a request needs HR (needs_hr_review, Cross-Border Review, a sensitive matter, a question HR
        handles, or the user asks for a person in HR) and the user agrees to raise it.
        Don't use when: the manager is the right approver (draft_manager_message), or for someone else.
